description: Tools for developing Simutrans addons: image viewer with Simutrans special colors, pak viewer and dat language support
config.pakSize: The size of one image cell (the pak size, such as 128) used when previewing images from dat files. An object's `cell_size=` takes precedence.
config.pakSizeOverrides: Pak sizes for specific dat files, as glob patterns relative to the workspace folder. The first matching pattern wins over `#simutrans-addon-tools.pakSize#`. Example: `{ "pak256/**": 256 }`
config.imagePreview: Show the image of the cell when hovering over an image in dat files.
config.diagnostics.ignoreReferences: Names that are referenced but defined outside the workspace, written as `obj/name` (example: `good/Kohle`). They are not warned about and are offered in completion. The default is the goods built into Simutrans.
config.diagnostics.unknownKey: Warn about keys that are not read for the object's `obj=` type.
config.diagnostics.unresolvedReference: Warn about referenced names (such as in `freight=` or `constraint`) that are not found in the workspace.
config.diagnostics.duplicateKey: Warn about keys (including subscripts) written more than once in an object. makeobj reads only the first one.
config.diagnostics.missingImage: Warn about image files that are not found and cells outside the image.
config.diagnostics.constraintMismatch: Show mismatched coupling settings (`constraint`): a warning when only one side is set, and an error when the vehicles cannot be coupled. A comment `# @ignore-one-sided` on the line before hides the one-sided warning for the next line.
config.diagnostics.constraintMismatchSev: Severity of coupling settings with which the vehicles cannot be coupled.
config.diagnostics.ignoreKeys: Keys not to warn about. `obj/key` limits it to one type (example: `vehicle/catering_level`).
